import sqlite3

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+DATA_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data"
+DIGEST_SCRIPT = PROJECT_ROOT / "scripts" / "digest.py"
+
+
+def _is_valid_relative_path(path: object) -> bool:
+    """Return True when path is a safe path relative to data/."""
+    if not isinstance(path, str) or path == "":
+        return False
+    if path.startswith("/"):
+        return False
+    for segment in path.split("/"):
+        if segment in ("", ".", ".."):
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_file_digest(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    path = params.get("path")
+    if not _is_valid_relative_path(path):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    if not (DATA_DIR / path).is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(DIGEST_SCRIPT), "--file", f"data/{path}"],
+        cwd=PROJECT_ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    return 200, json.loads(result.stdout)

from app.api.handlers import handle_file_digest
cases = [
    {"path": "readme.txt"}, {"path": "readme2.txt"},
    {"path": "sub dir/file name with $chars;.txt"},
    {}, {"path": None}, {"path": 123}, {"path": ""},
    {"path": "/etc/passwd"}, {"path": "a/../readme.txt"}, {"path": "../readme.txt"},
    {"path": "."}, {"path": ".."}, {"path": "a//b"}, {"path": "a/./b"},
    {"path": "readme.txt/"}, {"path": "nope.txt"}, {"path": "sub dir"},
]
ok = True
exp = {
    "readme.txt": 200, "readme2.txt": 200, "sub dir/file name with $chars;.txt": 200,
    None: 400, 123: 400, "": 400, "/etc/passwd": 400, "a/../readme.txt": 400,
    "../readme.txt": 400, ".": 400, "..": 400, "a//b": 400, "a/./b": 400,
    "readme.txt/": 400, "nope.txt": 404, "sub dir": 404,
}
for c in cases:
    r = handle_file_digest(c)
    want = exp.get(c.get("path"), 400 if "path" not in c else None)
    status = r[0]
    flag = "OK" if status == want else "FAIL"
    if flag == "FAIL": ok = False
    print(flag, repr(c.get("path")), "->", r)
print("ALL OK" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
EOF
echo "--- pytest ---"; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "--- ruff ---"; python -m ruff check --no-cache app 2>&1 | tail -3

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+DATA_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data"
+DIGEST_SCRIPT = PROJECT_ROOT / "scripts" / "digest.py"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_file_digest(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    path = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(path, str) or path == "" or path.startswith("/"):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in path.split("/")):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    if not (DATA_DIR / path).is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(DIGEST_SCRIPT), "--file", f"data/{path}"],
+        cwd=PROJECT_ROOT,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    return 200, json.loads(result.stdout)
